interface.signature: def isPossible(N: int, P: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of prerequisite pairs P is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < N and 0 <= v < N for u, v in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair [u, v] has valid task indices within the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (not any(cycle_exists(prerequisites, N)) and can_finish_all_tasks(prerequisites, N))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if it is possible to finish all tasks without any cycles in the prerequisite graph, otherwise False.
